_comment: Handgepflegt (Issue #99): Englischer 'Was ist neu'-Text für GENAU die Version im Feld 'version'. Der CHANGELOG ist nur deutsch und wird nicht maschinell übersetzt (Owner-Entscheidung) - 'title' und 'en' werden beim Release von Hand geschrieben, sinngemäß zum deutschen CHANGELOG-Abschnitt derselben Version. Der Generator (scripts/generate-whatsnew.mjs) übernimmt 'en' NUR, wenn 'version' hier exakt zur aktuellen APP_VERSION passt - sonst bleibt EN absichtlich leer, damit eine vergessene Übersetzung nicht lautlos durchrutscht (siehe web/scripts/check-whatsnew.mjs).
en:
Backup before updating recommended. On first start PokéCollect adds new tables for decks and new columns (deck per card, stage and trainer type in the catalog, Play! stamps, pattern prints); existing data stays as it is. Update the image matcher too — crop suggestions and the foil tools need its new version.

• New: decks — deck lists with legality checks (60 cards, at most 4 of a name, Basic Pokémon, ACE SPEC, Radiant, Standard/Expanded/Unlimited), import and export in the Pokémon TCG Live format, "Fill with my cards" (exact print first, then the cheapest), and scanning straight into a deck. Each card is in at most one deck and shows it (🃏).
• New: find picture (admin) for catalog cards without an image — suggestions from other languages and pokemontcg.io, Google/Bing search, paste or upload; your own copies without a picture get it too. Catalog filter "No picture".
• New: fix crop with suggestions — rough corners are enough; after each release the image matcher suggests the exact ones (dashed, green when it passes). Use it or keep your own corners.
• New: weak scans → "Fix crop all" tries the suggestions for every weak scan, shows old and new side by side and saves only after you confirm ("Confirm all that pass").
• New: mark the Play! stamp on Prize Pack photos (card page, admin list) — training data for a stamp detector.
• New: foil patterns — the card page shows which prints exist ("Exists as: Reverse Holo · Pokéball …"); a tap sets foiling and pattern, "?" explains the patterns. New patterns: Love/Quick/Friend/Dusk Ball, Cracked Ice, Crosshatch; Ascended Heroes patterns are recognized.
• New: scan dataset — foiling, pattern and catalog image per photo, stamp boxes (stamp.yaml); in the image matcher the tools holo_diff.py (foil by difference to the catalog image) and holo_cluster.py (sort foils into buckets).
• Changed: crop suggestions settle — the matcher crops again along its suggestion and refines until the corners stop moving.
• Changed: images from images.pokemontcg.io are allowed as card pictures (optional POKEMONTCG_API_KEY).
title: Decks, picture finder, crop suggestions and foil patterns
